alignment.preparation: Pinned 481e965 baseline. All original GB, Zhejiang OSM and previous seam objects retained byte-equivalent in the parsed feature superset. New JS95 and SH16 counties use stable OSM relation IDs; official 2026 name/code rosters. Two Suzhou county management geometries compose exact street polygons using official street codes. No inferred ownership for residuals. Exact directed same-snapshot physical coastline clipping; administrative sea never rendered as land. Outside old counties receive separate stable seam copies subtracting the 3-province raw union. Neutral fallback only historical-source enclosed inland residuals; exclude verified sea and whole components within .01 degree of physical coastline. No independent polygon simplification, buffering or artificial coast.
